name: wizeprep-study
description: Plan study sessions, review lessons, and practice with Wizeprep.

interface.longDescription: See what's on your Wizeprep study list, review lesson notes you can access, and practice one question at a time. You can also review flash cards from your courses. Course content depends on your Wizeprep account access. Course-wide progress and video playback are available on Wizeprep.
